name: Temple Sparring Hall (Temple of Mur)
desc: The Temple Sparring Hall is a large training area where the monks of the [Etrean Royalists](faction:etrean_royalists) practice fighting. It is located inside the [Temple of Mur](location:temple_of_mur). This Dungeon is where you fight the [Shogun of the Prophet's Guard](entity:shogun_of_the_prophets_guard_temple_of_mur) to progress your level past 5-10
